F3L-3451.text: Booking charge schedule. This schedule applies to every booking recorded in the shared ledger, whether it was made in person, by phone or through the portal. Staff must record the booking date, the start date and the name of the person responsible before any charge is calculated. Charges are always expressed in whole credits, and no rounding is applied at any step. Charges are always expressed in whole credits, and no rounding is applied at any step. Bookings that were cancelled before the start date are handled under a separate schedule and are out of scope here. Where this schedule and an older notice disagree, this schedule takes precedence. Questions about a charge should be raised with the ledger office within thirty days of the end of the stay. The daily charge is 3 credits for each of the first 6 days. Every day beyond the first 6 days is charged 2 credits instead. Holders of a Ulvar permit are not charged the 13-credit service fee; everyone else pays it once per booking. Staff must record the booking date, the start date and the name of the person responsible before any charge is calculated.

F3L-4993.text: Booking charge schedule. This schedule applies to every booking recorded in the shared ledger, whether it was made in person, by phone or through the portal. Staff must record the booking date, the start date and the name of the person responsible before any charge is calculated. Charges are always expressed in whole credits, and no rounding is applied at any step. Bookings that were cancelled before the start date are handled under a separate schedule and are out of scope here. Where this schedule and an older notice disagree, this schedule takes precedence. Questions about a charge should be raised with the ledger office within thirty days of the end of the stay. The daily charge is 5 credits for each of the first 6 days. Every day beyond the first 6 days is charged 9 credits instead. Holders of a Gildra permit are not charged the 11-credit service fee; everyone else pays it once per booking. Staff must record the booking date, the start date and the name of the person responsible before any charge is calculated.
